about_the_game:
Take command in the Rank Warmaster Bunker Buster Demo, where tactical control meets strategic execution bringing RTS elements to this sci-fi, action tower defense.

This demo includes the full tutorial (approx. 3 short levels) and missions 1–4 (out of 30 total), giving you access to all core systems and features of the full game.

FORTIFY AND FIGHT BACK

Protect your base by constructing perimeters and layered defenses against waves of unknown attackers. Every structure and unit placement matters as you balance resource management, defensive planning, and offensive strikes to survive.

ADVANCE YOUR ARSENAL

Research and develop diverse classes of airborne units. Update turrets with weapons and armor, and construct specialized buildings to enhance offensive and defensive capabilities.

The opening missions introduce the foundational tools and technologies that shape your strategic playstyle.

MULTIPLE VANTAGE POINTS

Seamlessly switch between the commander’s strategic view and direct control of turrets or airborne units, blending RTS precision with fast-paced action combat. Command from above or pilot from within, adapt your role to meet the moment.

REAL-TIME DECISIONS

Build, repair, and deploy reinforcements mid-battle as threats escalate. Conserve resources or risk it all for a tactical edge. Every choice impacts survival and success.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: i5 intel or above
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 1050 or above (Must support OpenGL 4.x and have 3+ GB of GPU RAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: You need a direct X compatible sound card (it will crash without one)

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
